object.attr: stakeholder: an agent can retry a refused call as a whole. Links are checked the same way (MELLON-TRACE-SRS-24). The tools' partial block covers only a file write that fails midway, which MELLON-STORE-SRS-175 settles (checked by the lead on 2026-11-11, review Q15).
object.description: If a new_object, update_object or bulk_set_attribute call holds an attribute name or value that Mellon refuses, the MCP server shall refuse the whole call before writing any file.
